title: With 'Open MettleUp on my watch' turned off, the watch still opens or pops up 'Workout started' with a buzz
what: The phone's switch 'Open MettleUp on my watch' only stops the phone's own open request. The watch has a backup: the first time the phone says a workout is open, the watch tries to open MettleUp itself and, if it cannot, pops up a 'Workout started' card with a buzz. The phone's workout message carries nothing about the switch, so the backup runs for every new workout even when the member turned the switch off.
expected: Switch off means the watch neither opens nor pops up anything when a workout starts.
how_often: every workout start with the switch off
fix_line: Send the switch with the workout message and let the watch's backup open only when it is on

title: With the watch's notifications off, the rest card, the 'Workout started' pop-up and the workout notice silently vanish
what: If the member says Not now or refuses the watch's notifications, the watch still buzzes at the end of a rest, but its rest countdown card with Done, +15 s and Skip, its 'Rest is over' card, the 'Workout started' pop-up and the 'Workout in progress' notice are all just not shown. The only trace is a line in the watch's own log. The phone's watch settings cannot see this, and the watch never asks again, so a member who turned on 'Open MettleUp on my watch' may get nothing when the watch cannot open by itself.
expected: The watch or the phone's watch page shows plainly that watch notifications are off and what that costs, with one tap to turn them on.
who: members with the watch app who refused notifications
fix_line: Show a lasting 'watch notifications off' line with a fix button on the watch and on the phone's watch page

title: The watch's 'Rest is over' card stays up after the set is logged when no new rest starts
what: When the member logs the set on the phone, the watch's own screen moves on, but its 'Rest is over · Next: ...' card is only removed by the next rest, the end of the workout, or its own two-minute timer. With the rest timer off, or after the last set before a long pause, the card keeps naming a set that is already done for up to two minutes.
expected: The card goes as soon as the set it points to is logged.
fix_line: Remove the 'Rest is over' card at the same moment the watch screen moves on
